drafts.text:
If you run a local shop, AI search is already reading your website.

A study of hundreds of thousands of local AI searches found most unique citations were individual business sites.

Not big directories. Your own page.

Real services. Real towns. Real photos.

drafts.text:
What most contractor websites get wrong:

They talk about the company.
Callers only care if you can fix the problem today.

Lead with the job. Phone number. Towns you cover.
Save the about page for later.

drafts.text:
AI can spin up a contractor site in five minutes.

It still can't tell if the phone number is tappable.
Or if the photos are yours.
Or if the town page is for a town you actually drive to.

That's the part I still do by hand.

drafts.text:
What a ground wire actually does

It's the escape route when something goes wrong.

Hot and neutral carry power. Ground sits quiet until a fault, then gives current a safe path so the breaker trips.

No ground? A tool case can become live.
drafts.pattern: Plain What/Why explainer (question_explainer hook shape from today's sweatystartup opener + electrician teach pattern)
drafts.video_tip: Close-up of a 3-prong outlet or open box showing the bare ground. 5 seconds, vertical, point at the ground screw. No music.

drafts.text:
What homeowners get wrong about flickering lights

One blink when the AC kicks on can be normal.
Lights that flicker all day are not.

Could be a loose connection. Those get hot.

If rooms dim when a big appliance starts, call before it gets worse.
